eventPolicy.costRule: Keep paid events and record cost/registration fields when visible.
eventPolicy.sourceUrlRule: Every event must keep the original event page or source calendar URL.
eventPolicy.qualityRule: Every import must check time, place, coordinates, source URL, and activity summary before writing events.json; summaries must contain only useful activity content, not date, time, venue, room, place, or address text; automatically repair deterministic gaps and report anything still missing.

requiredChecks: address when available from the source
official page text first, then image/flyer text for address, time, room, and venue only when HTML text is incomplete
lat/lng for every in-coverage event shown on the map
summary with concrete activity content only, excluding date, time, venue, room, place, and address text
sourceUrl or url pointing back to the original event page
autoRepair: Copy url and sourceUrl from each other when one is missing.
Copy venue and venueName from each other when one is missing.
Fill timezone from eventPolicy.timezone when startsAt is present.
Calculate durationMinutes from startsAt and endsAt when possible.
Use source library/location coordinates first, then town center fallback, then address geocoding for missing in-coverage lat/lng.
Clean generic source-page/update/registration filler and date/time/place/address/venue text out of summaries.
importQuality.unresolvedReportRule: If time, place, coordinates, source URL, or concrete summary are still missing after auto-repair, print an import quality audit with counts and sample event IDs/titles for manual review.
importQuality.contentRule: Do not invent activity descriptions. Extract concrete activity content from the source page when possible; if unavailable, leave summary empty and report it. Put date, time, venue, room, place, and address only in structured fields such as startsAt, endsAt, timeLabel, venueName, venue, and address, never in summary.
importQuality.imageTextRule: Always inspect official page HTML text first. Only when the page text does not provide the needed address, time, room, or venue detail should the importer inspect image alt/title/captions or OCR-visible flyer text; if the importer cannot read the image text, report the event/source for manual image review.

sourceStatusVocabulary.importable: Importer should automatically read this source and write events to data/events.json.
sourceStatusVocabulary.manual_review: Source is useful but does not have a stable importer yet; keep the link and parser notes.
sourceStatusVocabulary.service_area: Town is covered by a system source or nearby branch, but there is not a separate branch feed to import.
sourceStatusVocabulary.blocked_by_bot_protection: Source is useful but direct script fetching is blocked; keep it for future browser-backed or manual review.
sourceStatusVocabulary.reference_only: Keep as a directory, venue, or planning reference; do not import events automatically.

appDisplayPolicy.townMenuRule: The More menu displays short town names without Township, Borough, or City suffixes.
appDisplayPolicy.zipRule: Single-ZIP towns show ZIP right-aligned without parentheses; multi-ZIP towns show a parent town row with indented community ZIP rows.
appDisplayPolicy.librarySearchColorRule: Towns with at least one library source marked importable are highlighted in the More menu.
appDisplayPolicy.placeNameRule: Event detail place names may be shortened for display, but source data should keep the original venue name for refresh and review.

workflow: Add the town to towns[] with id, name, county, geoid when known, center, distanceMiles, and within-coverage status.
Find and store source links first: municipal/recreation links in towns[].municipal, library links in towns[].libraries[], and reusable or venue-specific links in sharedSources or regionalSources.
Mark each source with type, status from sourceStatusVocabulary, parser, website, eventsUrl, address/lat/lng when available, and notes about access or parser limits.
Run scripts/import-source-events.mjs to refresh data/events.json from importable sources while keeping older events.
Let the app read data/events.json only; events outside the 20-minute coverage can stay in JSON but should not appear in the app until they are mapped to coverage.
